Ukraine Peace Talks Stall Amid Escalating Airstrikes and New Russian Tactics

Ukraine peace talks have stalled since February, with a new round approaching amidst an escalation of Russian and Ukrainian airstrikes. Russia has employed new tactics against Ukrainian drones, as seen in an assault on Hannivka. These tactics exploited poor weather, utilized small assault teams, and employed FPV drone interceptors to counter Ukraine's drone defenses. The conflict continues with a deadly campaign of aerial attacks from both sides.
